title: Smart Data Models - DCSA Track & Trace - ShipmentEvent
description: The shipment event entity is a specialization of the event entity to support specification of data that only applies to a shipment event. (DCSA Track & Trace 2.2.0, OpenAPI component shipmentEvent; field names kept verbatim; deprecated fields left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ShipmentEvent:<eventID>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ShipmentEvent'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

eventID.description: Property. Model:'https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/dcsaorg/DCSA_TNT/2.2.0#/components/schemas/eventID'. The unique identifier for the event (the message - not the source). NB: This field should be considered Metadata

eventCreatedDateTime.description: Property. Model:'https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/dcsaorg/DCSA_TNT/2.2.0#/components/schemas/eventCreatedDateTime'. The timestamp of when the event was created. NB: This field should be considered Metadata

eventType.description: Property. Model:'https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/dcsaorg/DCSA_TNT/2.2.0#/components/schemas/eventType'. The Event Type of the object - to be used as a discriminator. NB: This field should be considered Metadata

eventClassifierCode.description: Property. Model:'https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/dcsaorg/DCSA_TNT/2.2.0#/components/schemas/eventClassifierCode'. Code for the event classifier can be - ACT (Actual) - PLN (Planned) - EST (Estimated)

eventDateTime.description: Property. Model:'https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/dcsaorg/DCSA_TNT/2.2.0#/components/schemas/eventDateTime'. Value for eventDateTime must be the same value as eventCreatedDateTime

shipmentEventTypeCode.description: Property. Model:'https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/dcsaorg/DCSA_TNT/2.2.0#/components/schemas/shipmentEventTypeCode'. The status of the document in the process. Possible values are - RECE (Received) - DRFT (Drafted) - PENA (Pending Approval) - PENU (Pending Update) - REJE (Rejected) - APPR (Approved) - ISSU (Issued) - SURR (Surrendered) - SUBM (Submitted) - VOID (Void) - CONF (Confirmed) - REQS (Requested) - CMPL (Completed) - HOLD (On Hold) - RELS (Released) More details can be found on GitHub

documentID.description: Property. Model:'https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/dcsaorg/DCSA_TNT/2.2.0#/components/schemas/documentID'. The id of the object defined by the documentTypeCode.

documentTypeCode.description: Property. Model:'https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/dcsaorg/DCSA_TNT/2.2.0#/components/schemas/documentTypeCode'. The code to identify the type of information documentID points to. Can be one of the following values - CBR (Carrier Booking Request Reference) - BKG (Booking) - SHI (Shipping Instruction) - SRM (Shipment Release Message) - TRD (Transport Document) - ARN (Arrival Notice) - VGM (Verified Gross Mass) - CAS (Cargo Survey) - CUS (Customs Inspection) - DGD (Dangerous Goods Declaration) - OOG (Out of Gauge) More details can be found on GitHub

reason.description: Property. Model:'https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/dcsaorg/DCSA_TNT/2.2.0#/components/schemas/reason'. Reason field in a Shipment event. This field can be used to explain why a specific event has been sent.

referenceType.description: The reference type codes defined by DCSA. - FF (Freight Forwarder’s Reference) - SI (Shipper’s Reference) - PO (Purchase Order Reference) - CR (Customer’s Reference) - AAO (Consignee’s Reference) - EQ (Equipment Reference)

referenceValue.description: The actual value of the reference.

items.description: references provided by the shipper or freight forwarder at the time of booking or at the time of providing shipping instruction. Carriers share it back when providing track and trace event updates, some are also printed on the B/L. Customers can use these references to track shipments in their internal systems.
